subject: Rebaseline request: MAP & acceptance window change
messages:

Cc: Oliver Ng <oliver.ng@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tentative acceptance date slipping — need MAP update

Hi Marissa / Jonas,

Quick heads-up from our side: internal testing uncovered a compatibility gap in our telemetry layer that pushes our acceptance window out ~3 weeks. Procurement is still aligned but needs an updated MAP + evaluation plan before they can reissue the PO (they need the new acceptance date and metrics).

Current target (as of last week): 2028-06-30
New tentative target: 2028-07-21

Can you update the MAP and call out the acceptance criteria and any adjusted milestones? If there are any material pricing or SLA items that change, flag them now so we can accelerate procurement review.

I attached the MAP we were using (Acme-MAP-v1.pdf) for your reference. Oliver will be the procurement lead on this.

Thanks,
Emma

--
Emma Sanders
Head of Platform Integrations, Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tentative acceptance date slipping — need MAP update

Emma, Oliver —

Thanks for the flag. We can rebaseline the MAP; attached is a proposed update that shifts the final acceptance to 2028-07-21 and adds two contingency gates: a pre-eval smoke test window (6/28–7/01) and a canary cutover (7/11–7/13). Key asks from our side:

- Updated evaluation checklist from Acme (exact telemetry tests + pass/fail thresholds)
- Confirmation on who will sign the PO once dates change (procurement contact vs. technical approver)

Impact note: with the shifted timeline we recommend holding the current pricing but adding a one-time buffer credit clause (see worksheet under “contingency economics”). If procurement requires a formal SOW change, that could add ~3 business days to execution for signature routing.

Proposed attachments: RDW-proposed-rebaseline-map-20280607.xlsx (contains milestones, rollback windows, and risk log).

If that looks okay, I’ll route the MAP to Karthik for an approval exception on the contingency credit and then send a consolidated MAP + mutual action sign-off to procurement.

Next steps / ask: Emma — can Oliver confirm the eval checklist by EOD Monday 6/11?

Best,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jun 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tentative acceptance date slipping — need MAP update

Internal note — keeping this thread for context before we escalate.

Marissa, Rishi — quick risk log snapshot after reviewing the proposed rebaseline:

- Risk 1: Eval spec drift — Acme’s telemetry tests may require additional infra hooks; if they request feature work, that’s scope creep. Mitigation: request explicit pass/fail criteria and sign-off on the checklist before we trigger canary.
- Risk 2: Procurement cadence — shifting the date pushes their finance cycle into a different approval batch (possible 7/25 cut-off). Mitigation: ask procurement to confirm final PO sign-off path and any blackout dates.
- Risk 3: SLA exposure — extended acceptance window increases our exposure to incidents in the final mile. Mitigation: add a 2-week rolling incident credit cap in the event the canary hits regressions.

I think this needs Karthik’s approval for the contingency credit (it’s outside standard commercial terms) — recommend escalation with a short exec summary and the risk log attached. If approved, instruct legal to prepare a one-page amendment to the MSA that references the MAP and credits.

I can draft the exec summary; Marissa, if you can route Karthik and cc legal (Rishi), we can move quickly.

-Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 9 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tentative acceptance date slipping — need MAP update

Thanks for the background and the clear mitigation options. I reviewed the risk log and the proposed contingency credit. Approved under the following conditions:

1) MAP must include the explicit evaluation checklist and signature lines for technical and procurement approvers (Emma + Oliver).
2) The one-time contingency credit is capped at the lesser of $25k or 2% of contract value and expires if acceptance completes by 2028-07-14.
3) Legal (cc: Rishi) to issue a short amendment to the MSA reflecting the revised acceptance date and credit terms — target turnaround 3 business days upon checklist sign-off.

Marissa — please confirm you will: (a) incorporate the checklist into the MAP, (b) push the MAP to Emma/Oliver for sign-off, and (c) share the HubSpot deal update with the new dates so finance can see the adjusted forecast. Once legal issues the amendment, notify me and I’ll sign the approval.

I’ve copied Acme to keep them in the loop on the approved guardrails.

Karthik
